Innovation through formulation.

# Azelis is the reference innovation service provider in the speciality chemicals and food
# ingredients industry

[Touching the lives of people everywhere][74] [Our commitments to the wider community][75]

.

### Innovation

As a speciality distributor of chemicals and food ingredients, we’re now a fully integrated,
leading, innovative service provider. With innovation and collaboration at our heart, we believe
anything is possible.
* [Application laboratories][76]
* [Sampling and evaluation][77]
* [REACH compliance management][78]
* [International supply chain][79]

.

### Markets

Azelis services fifteen specific markets worldwide, bringing high-quality products, technical
expertise and local service support to each. Our international team is united in its hunger and
humility. Collaborating across 70+ laboratories to be a benchmark for innovation. A focus for
ambitious brands. And a catalyst that helps our customers to solve challenges and improve lives.
* [Life Sciences][80]
* [Industrial Chemicals][81]

.

### Customer Portal

The Azelis Customer Portal is a connected experience that inspires you with trends and inspirational
content for your selected markets, linking you to formulations, products, and related documentation.
From one digital experience you can order samples, request quotes and reorder products from Azelis.

Register at [Explore.Azelis.com][82]

[Visit the Customer Portal ][83]

.

### Sustainability

At Azelis, we are committed to maintaining high human, environmental and ethical values. That is
only possible thanks to the cooperation of local communities, industry bodies, authorities, and/or
regulators, and with you.* *
* [Our sustainability programme][84]
* [Our 2025 Integrated Report][85]
* [Our sustainability policies][8

Employment Opportunities
Working at Azelis

We embrace change as an invaluable opportunity to grow, learn and become even better at what we do.
As do our people. Azelis currently employs more than 4,100 talented individuals in 64 countries. And
counting.

## We are Azelis

Together with our 65,000+ customers we provide effective, sustainable and reliable business
solutions, developing innovative ways to create value. We are Azelis.

### Work with us

We currently employ more than 4,100 people across the world in 64 countries. We value highly
competent, forward-looking people.

Are you looking to work for a highly dynamic and innovative company where you can unleash your
talent? [Then you’re in the right place.][93]

[Discover our career opportunities][94]

### Corporate social responsibility

We take our responsibilities seriously and work with employees and stakeholders to reduce the
environmental impact of our work and to improve the social value in what we do, wherever we get the
opportunity.

***Against slavery and human trafficking***

We are committed to ensuring modern slavery does not take place within our business or supply
chains. 

[Learn more][95]
We provide high quality raw materials, sourced from leading global manufacturers. Our technical team
can provide you with sampling, formulation and expertise.

## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

[Product Information][112]
[Watch Video][113]

Find the right Huntsman product for you

[Product Finder][114]

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

lightweight, shock-resistant, thermally optimized and structurally strong – supporting OEMs and
battery manufacturers as they work to enhance the next generation of batteries powering EVs.

## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

effectively used in a range of applications from the production of urea-formaldehyde resins to being
used as an anti-caking agent for the urea fertilizer.

  SS Tanks & ISO Container

[Know More][14]
[Balaji formalin Formaldehyde product blue barrel and carboy ]

### Paraformaldehyde

White Crystalline Solid, extensively used as fumigant, disinfectant and adhesives. Being an
extremely flammable and high friction product, our paraformaldehyde prills are delivered in premium
anti-static LDPE bags to ensure zero hazards.
We offer Best in Class 96% Paramformaldehyde prills for catering to a diverse range of industrial
sectors. Our exhaustive quality control checks and product testing verifies that each lot is
consistently top grade.
* [25kgs LDPE Bags]
  25kgs LDPE Bags
* [500/1000 Anti Static Jumbo Bags]
  500/1000 Anti Static Jumbo Bags
* [Custom Sizing Options Available]
  Custom Sizing Options Available

[Know More][15]
[25 KG LPG bag of Paraformaldehyde]

### Urea Formaldehyde Concentrate - 85%

Urea Formaldehyde Concentrate - 85% or UFC85 is a clear & viscous liquid with immense benefits. It
is a unique blend of formaldehyde, urea & water in the ratios 60%, 25%, 15% respectively. It is
effectively used in a range of applications from the production of urea-formaldehyde resins to being
used as an anti-caking agent for the urea fertilizer.
* [250 Kgs. Barrel]

[Know More][16]

[Manufacturing factory of Balaji Formalin]

## Production
## Powerhouse

Sprawling across 20 acres in Gujarat & Maharastra, we have one of the largest Paraformaldehyde and
Formaldehyde manufacturing facilities in India. We are capable of delivering best in class 3L MTPA
Formaldehyde and 20K MTPA Paraformaldehyde. To ensure our commitment toward a greener and cleaner
future all our facilities are State Laws and EPA compliant.

[Know More][17]
[vector]

## Quality Par
## Excellence

With mammoth production comes the great challenge of ensuring purity and consistency. We are the
only Paraformaldehyde facility in India & South Central Asia with ISO 9001,14001 & 45001
Certifications. With over 200 skilled minds and a rigorous quality testing process starting from raw
materials to finished goods, the quality we deliver is unmatched & thoroughly consistent.

[Know More][18]
[A women technician is testing at various stages of the production of Formaldehyde ]
[A person prepares the Formaldehyde sample for testing ]
[A technician is testing the Raw Material for the production of Paraformaldehyde ]
[Balaji Formalin ISO certificate - 2015]
[Balaji Formalin ISO certificate - 2018]
[Balaji Formalin ISO certificate - 14001.2015]
[Certification for commitment to sustainability]
[vector]

## Safely Packed,
## Smartly Delivered

Our trained hands ensure premium quality packaging, couple that with our in house fleet of SS grade
tanks, you have a product in top notch unadulterated condition delivered straight to your doorstep
via the most efficient route possible. Our large size ready to go inventory ensures on-time
lightning fast delivery. Products are carefully packed to prevent any spillover or hazards. The Pre
and Post Order Support makes the entire ordering experience snappy and wonderful.

[Know More][19]
[Formaldehyde products are ready for delivery from Balaji Formalin production facility by logistical
vehicle]

Realizing the vision of a prosperous future is a constant work in progress. At Balaji Formalin, we

**Changyu Pump** is a trusted **chemical pump manufacturer** established in 2006, specializing
in corrosion-resistant pump solutions for aggressive and complex fluids. Our main products
include magnetic drive pumps, centrifugal pumps, self-priming pumps, slurry pumps, and submersible
pumps, widely used in chemical processing, electroplating, wastewater treatment, mining, and
environmental applications.

Backed by strong manufacturing capability and industry experience, we help global customers improve
fluid transfer safety, reduce leakage risk, and achieve long-term operating reliability with
professional **industrial pump systems** and customized service.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Are you a manufacturer or trading company?

A: We are a professional manufacturer in chemical pumps with high quality for more than 20 years.

Q: How to customize pumps and mechanical seals ?

A: Customers could send us application data, we will select suitable pump and seal types, or client
could send us drawings, We are well in OEM and ODM.

Q: How can I pay for my items? Which kind of payment can you provide?

A: Usually by T/T, 30% payment after PI confirmed, the 70% balance should be paid after inspection
before shipment. and L/C at sight.

Q: What information should I offer for quotation?

Medium: ******________******
PH: ________
Specific gravity: ________
Medium temperature: ________
Flow: ________m3/h
Head: _________m
Voltage: ____________V

[Surfactants][176] [
Dotachem is a high quality supplier & manufacturer of surfactant in China, our hot products
including Nonylphenol Ethoxylate, Nonylphenol, Lauryl Alcohol Ethoxylate, Polyethylene Glycol,
Octylphenol Ethoxylate, Sodium Lauryl Ether Sulphate, Cetearyl Alcohol Ethoxylate, Polyoxyethylene
Sorbitan Fatty Acid Ester (TWEEN), etc. The company primarily deals in various surfactant and
chemical intermediates, which are fine chemicals at the forefront of various industries. And we have
a application technology R&D center, equipped with a professional technical team to offer in-depth
application research and technical support services to customers.

Surfactants play a crucial role in textile and leather chemicals, industrial and commercial
cleaning, industrial lubricants, coatings and building materials, oilfields, and water treatment.
With a focus on purity, safety, and efficiency, you can rely on the quality of our surfactants and
count on us as your partner for reliable, timely service and expertise in the supply chain.

We have ISO9001:2015 quality management system certification and hazardous chemicals business
license which shows that we can continue to provide  Nonylphenol Ethoxylate, Nonylphenol, Lauryl
Alcohol Ethoxylate, Polyethylene Glycol, Octylphenol Ethoxylate, Sodium Lauryl Ether Sulphate,
Cetearyl Alcohol Ethoxylate, Polyoxyethylene Sorbitan Fatty Acid Ester(TWEEN) and other products
that meet international standards and qualified quality. Our team of surfactant specialists is
dedicated to assisting you in developing innovative products, meeting regulatory standards,
addressing formulation or supply challenges, and optimizing product costs. We are committed to
serving as your trusted partner, delivering the solutions you need, precisely when you need them,
and at competitive prices. Explore our range of surfactant manufacturing products today.][177]
[[Amines]][178]
[Amines][179] [
Dotachem is a leading global supplier of Diethanolamine、Monoethanolamine and Ethanolamine based in
China. We collaborate closely with our clients to create tailored products that meet their specific
needs and address their diverse requirements in terms of quality, specifications, and supply chain
management. Our emphasis on technology, large-scale manufacturing capabilities, and competitive
pricing distinguishes us as the preferred partner for amine supply.

Amines constitute an important class of organic compounds derived by replacing one or more hydrogen
atoms of ammonia molecule by alkyl/aryl group(s), widely used in the pharmaceutical industry, in
medications, personal care products, gas treatment, cement production, chemicals for crop
protection, personal care products, and more.

All of our amines products including Diethanolamine, Monoethanolamine, Ethanolamine are developed by
professional scientists and engineers in our technical center, a team with more than 10 years of
research and development experience, applying our technical capabilities to the provision and
service of amine products. Our diverse products are widely exported to countries in the Middle East,
Europe and East Asia.][180]
[[Phenols]][181]
[Phenols][182] [
Our top selling products including Nonylphenol, Octylphenol and p-tert-Butylphenol. For your
industrial and chemical needs, trust in Dotachem to develop top of the line, customized phenols for
your specific application, and our mission is to be a premier phenol supplier and Manufacturer.

Phenols are a class of compounds that consist of hydroxyl (-OH) groups directly combined with
aromatic hydrocarbon groups and are produced by plants and microorganisms. Because they are widely

same chemical compound, sodium carbonate, but in physically different forms. Glass plants need dense
soda ash for the free-flowing batch handling their furnaces require. Detergent makers need light
soda ash that dissolves rapidly into formulation. Buying the wrong grade creates real operational
problems downstream, which is why grade selection is the first procurement decision soda ash buyers
actually make. Elchemy supplies ELRASA™-SAL Soda Ash in both dense and light grades to industrial
buyers across 40+ countries, with quality matched to glass-grade, detergent-grade, and

# Sodium Laureth Sulphate (SLES)

## ELSURFAC^{TM} – SES70

Elchemy supplies ELSURFAC™-SES70 Sodium Laureth Sulphate (SLES) in bulk to personal care, home care,
and industrial cleaning manufacturers across 40+ countries. SLES is a high-performance anionic
surfactant valued for its strong cleansing and foaming action with reduced irritation compared to
SLS, making it a workhorse ingredient in shampoos, body washes, hand soaps, dishwashing liquids, and
laundry detergents. Formulators planning a sodium laureth sulfate buy can source standard SLES 70%
in both 2EO and 3EO variants, with other active levels and customer-specific specifications
available on request. Domestic stock is also held at our US warehouses for faster fulfillment to US
destinations.

# Linear Alkylbenzene Sulfonic Acid (LABSA)

## ELSURFAC^{TM} – LSA90

Elchemy supplies ELSURFAC™-LSA Linear Alkylbenzene Sulfonic Acid (LABSA) in bulk to detergent
manufacturers, household and industrial cleaning formulators, and chemical processors across 40+
countries. LABSA is the single highest-volume synthetic surfactant in the world by industrial use,
valued as the active backbone of laundry detergents, dishwashing liquids, hand wash, and industrial
cleaners. The product is supplied at 96% active matter, which is the dominant global commercial
grade, with other active levels and customer-specific specifications available on request. Domestic
stock is also held at our US warehouses for faster fulfillment to US destinations.

Elchemy supplies ELSURFAC™-CAB35 Cocamidopropyl Betaine (CAPB) in bulk to personal care and cosmetic

secondary surfactant in shampoos, body washes, facial cleansers, baby care products, and
sulfate-free formulations, valued for its mild cleansing action and rich foam profile. Formulators
looking to buy cocamidopropyl betaine at consistent active content can source standard 30% and 35%
grades, with other active levels and customer-specific specifications available on request. Domestic

[Glycerine]
Top Product

# Glycerine

## ELHUME^{TM} – GLO G3

Glycerine (also known as Glycerin or Propane-1,2,3-triol) is a clear, odorless, and non-toxic liquid
renowned for its exceptional moisturizing and humectant properties. It plays a vital role across
multiple industries — including personal care, pharmaceuticals, food, and chemicals — for its
ability to attract and retain moisture. Trusted refined glycerine suppliers ensure consistent purity
and performance for industrial and cosmetic applications worldwide. Glycerine is a versatile and
widely used ingredient in the chemical industry, known for its ability to retain moisture and
maintain hydration in various formulations. Produced from both plant and animal sources, glycerine
is a clear, odorless, and non-toxic liquid that holds a significant place in the beauty,
pharmaceutical, and cosmetic sectors. Glycerine Manufacturers focus on producing high-quality, pure
glycerine that meets strict industry standards. The product’s adaptability is a major advantage for
manufacturers involved in custom chemical manufacturing, where consistent performance and purity are
critical.
View Details
Request Sample/Quote
[Soda Ash]
Top Product

# Soda Ash

## ELRASA^{TM} – SAL

Two industries dominate global soda ash demand: glass manufacturing and detergents. They use the
same chemical compound, sodium carbonate, but in physically different forms. Glass plants need dense
soda ash for the free-flowing batch handling their furnaces require. Detergent makers need light
soda ash that dissolves rapidly into formulation. Buying the wrong grade creates real operational
problems downstream, which is why grade selection is the first procurement decision soda ash buyers
actually make. Elchemy supplies ELRASA™-SAL Soda Ash in both dense and light grades to industrial
buyers across 40+ countries, with quality matched to glass-grade, detergent-grade, and
chemical-processing-grade specifications. Domestic stock is also held at our US warehouses for
faster fulfillment.
View Details

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate

# Welcome to Multichem

##### Your Trusted Partner in Chemical Distribution Solutions

As a second-generation, **50 year old family owned chemical import distribution company based in
Mumbai - the financial heart of India**. We are dedicated to delivering top-quality products and
exceptional service. With an extensive ready stock and a streamlined logistics network, we ensure
timely, seamless deliveries that meet the needs of our clients. Our commitment to global standards
reflects our focus on reliability, sustainability, and long-term partnerships, making us a trusted
name in the industry.

Our unwavering commitment to excellence, customer satisfaction, and ethical business practices has
enabled us to forge enduring relationships with clients across India and around the globe. As we
continue to expand, our focus remains on delivering superior products, exceptional service, and
sustainable solutions that drive progress in the industries of today and tomorrow.

At Multichem, we don’t just supply chemicals - we cultivate partnerships that empower success.

## Testimonials

We have been buying various chemicals and pharmaceutical intermediates from Multichem since about
2009. Over the years, they have demonstrated excellence in product quality and service consistently.
Being in the pharmaceutical sector, quality and reliability are extremely important and Multichem
has always delivered on both fronts. Their team’s expertise, timely delivery, and commitment to
understanding our unique needs have made them an invaluable part of our supply chain. We look
forward to continuing our strong collaboration with Multichem in the years to come.

professionalism.

###### Pedro Garcia Giacon

years. Initially, I worked with the late Mr. Shiv Dayal Karnani, whose dedication to quality and

son Manish, that legacy of excellence continues. Multichem’s consistent quality and professionalism
have been invaluable to our operations, and I look forward to many more successful years of
collaboration.

have made them a reliable partner, and we look forward to building a strong, long-term relationship.

excellence and attention to detail make them a reliable partner for handling complex customs
processes. It has been a pleasure collaborating with such a dedicated team.

true partner in our growth journey.

## Our word is our bond.

Best-in-class customer service
Easy and efficient logistics
Quality, reliable products
Superb value

As a multi-generational family-led business, we provide **unparalleled service** with direct access
to leadership and decision-makers—**ensuring your needs are addressed promptly and personally**.

Our **seamless logistics** network allows us to import and distribute materials from around the
world, **delivering to your facility with precision timing** through strategically located North
American warehouses.

Every chemical in our portfolio comes from [strictly vetted global producers][29], ensuring
**consistent, high-quality materials** that **meet your exact technical specifications** every time.

We provide alternative sources for critical raw materials, assuring **supply continuity** while
delivering competitive pricing **that positively impacts your bottom line**.

# Omya ranked #7 globally in chemical distribution

##### Our combined businesses, Omya Specialty Materials and Omya Performance Polymer Distribution,
##### are ranked 3rd in Europe and 7th globally in the 2025 ICIS top 100 chemical distributors
##### listing.

[Read more][248]
[Omya Specialty Materials Hero Image]

# Omya Specialty Materials

##### One-stop shop technical solutions for customers worldwide through the global distribution of
##### minerals and chemicals.

[Learn more about Omya Specialty Materials][249]
[Science Molecule DNA Model Structure, business teamwork concept 270524519]

# Omya Performance Polymer Distribution

##### Your global distribution partner for high-performance, engineering and standard polymers, and
##### rubber polymers and additives.

[Discover Omya Performance Polymer Distribution][250]

## Our business units
* [
  
  ## Omya Specialty Materials
  
  Global sales and distribution for a wide range of specialist minerals, pigments, binders,
  additives, and life science ingredients.
  [OSM header]
  ][251]
* [
  
  ## Omya Performance Polymer Distribution
  
  Global distribution of high-performance, engineering and standard polymers, and rubber polymers
  and additives.
  [OPPD_Header_image]
  ][252]

## Thinking of Tomorrow

For over 140 years, Omya has been using natural minerals and chemistry to improve life for current
and future generations. Our scientists work closely with customers and partners across the world,
using our Horizon Framework to consider the short, medium and long term issues facing our planet and
society.

[Learn more about innovation][253]

## Omya is a leading global producer of essential minerals and a worldwide distributor of specialty
## materials.

[Explore our story][254]

### Technical expertise and application development

With scientists in 50 countries and 17 dedicated laboratories across the world, Omya offers
laboratory analysis, technical expertise, and application development to customers and partners
globally.

 

We support process efficiencies, formulation optimization, and functionality improvements to
increase performance.

[Learn more about innovation][255]
[Innovation]

## Sustainability is key to our success and that of our customers

At Omya, sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Our approach is twofold: we focus on
enhancing our own performance across social, environmental, and economic dimensions, and we are
dedicated to helping our customers achieve their sustainability goals.

 

Our natural mineral solutions are designed to have a low carbon footprint, offering a more
sustainable alternative to many of the materials they replace.

[Learn more][256]
[Sunlight in the green forest]

## Join the Omya team

With 9,000 people employed across more than 50 countries, Omya offers exceptional career
opportunities to talented individuals with the determination to succeed.

 

If you have a passion for minerals and chemistry, and would like to be part of our team, we’d love
to hear from you.

[See our job openings][257]
[Career opportunities at Omya]

### Omya facts and figures

At Omya, we take a long-term approach to business, ensuring sustainability and growth for both our
company and our customers. Here are some key facts and figures about Omya:

##### are ranked 3rd in Europe and 7th globally in the 2025 ICIS top 100 chemical distributors

##### One-stop shop technical solutions for customers worldwide through the global distribution of
##### minerals and chemicals.

[Learn more about Omya Specialty Materials][249]
[Science Molecule DNA Model Structure, business teamwork concept 270524519]

# Omya Performance Polymer Distribution

##### Your global distribution partner for high-performance, engineering and standard polymers, and
##### rubber polymers and additives.

[Discover Omya Performance Polymer Distribution][250]

## Our business units
* [
  
  ## Omya Specialty Materials
  
  Global sales and distribution for a wide range of specialist minerals, pigments, binders,
  additives, and life science ingredients.

  ][251]

  Global distribution of high-performance, engineering and standard polymers, and rubber polymers
  and additives.

## Thinking of Tomorrow

For over 140 years, Omya has been using natural minerals and chemistry to improve life for current
and future generations. Our scientists work closely with customers and partners across the world,
using our Horizon Framework to consider the short, medium and long term issues facing our planet and
society.

[Learn more about innovation][253]

## Omya is a leading global producer of essential minerals and a worldwide distributor of specialty
## materials.

[Explore our story][254]

### Technical expertise and application development

With scientists in 50 countries and 17 dedicated laboratories across the world, Omya offers
laboratory analysis, technical expertise, and application development to customers and partners
globally.

 

We support process efficiencies, formulation optimization, and functionality improvements to
increase performance.

[Learn more about innovation][255]
[Innovation]

## Sustainability is key to our success and that of our customers

At Omya, sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. Our approach is twofold: we focus on
enhancing our own performance across social, environmental, and economic dimensions, and we are
dedicated to helping our customers achieve their sustainability goals.

 

Our natural mineral solutions are designed to have a low carbon footprint, offering a more
sustainable alternative to many of the materials they replace.

[Learn more][256]
[Sunlight in the green forest]

## Join the Omya team

With 9,000 people employed across more than 50 countries, Omya offers exceptional career
opportunities to talented individuals with the determination to succeed.

 

If you have a passion for minerals and chemistry, and would like to be part of our team, we’d love
to hear from you.

[See our job openings][257]
[Career opportunities at Omya]

About Us
Focusing on chemicals for 70+ years, professional chemical supplier
Nanjing Chemical Material Corp. (NCMC), honored as the president unit of Nanjing Chemical Industry
Association, is reformed from original state-owned company which was found in 1955. NCMC has been
developing and focusing on chemicals for 70 years, and now is one of the largest professional
chemical suppliers in Jiangsu Province, with the privilege authorized by China government for
operation of hazardous chemicals, highly toxic chemicals, precursor and explosive chemicals. Taking
application development as the core mission, NCMC provides customers professional chemical services
with an integrated portfolio including manufacturing, R&D, trading, storage and logistics. The
products range includes basic chemicals, inorganic chemicals, intermediates, functional chemicals,
specialty and custom-made chemicals, covering total 14 application industries.

  Expertise·Precision
  Specialty·Innovation
  R&D Center
  
  NCMC R&D Center, founded in 2013, is located in Collaborative Innovation Center of Nanjing Tech
  University in Nanjing Jiangbei New Area, covering 1000 square meters so far. The center is
  equipped by advanced R&D instruments and devices, and owns a professional and dedicated team led
  by high-qualified experts in technical research. “Expertise, Precision, Specialty, Innovation” are
  our core development goals, with the prospect of more resilient industrial diversification
  achievement in the long run.
  
  The core technical capabilities of the center:
  
  1) Separation and purification of lithium salts, precious metal salts and iodides.
  
  2) Formulation of grease and industrial cleaning.
  
  3) Developing special PU resin based on organic and inorganic hybrid modification.
  
  4) Developing high-performance composite materials applied in automobile, new energy and
  infrastructure fields.
  
  Learn more >
  ][92]

  14
  large-scale warehousing and logistics base
  
  Taking Yangtze River Delta as the center which radiating the whole country. In the Yangtze River
  Delta, Pearl River Delta and Bohai Bay area, NCMC has signed cooperation contracts with a number
  of large storage companies, including non-dangerous warehouse, hazardous chemical warehouse and
  liquid bulk chemical storage tanks. Some of our warehouses can provide personalized services,
  including container handling and storage, unpacking and packing, bulk packaging, palleting and
  wrapping, sampling and sorting, etc. At present, NCMC has 9 large solid warehouses with an area of
  30,000 square meters, 5 large liquid logistics bases with storage tank capacity of 35,000 cubic
  meters. Storing chemicals include general chemicals, dangerous chemicals covering all classes of
  A, B and C, and special chemicals (highly toxic, precursor and explosive chemicals, etc.)

About Us
Focusing on chemicals for 70+ years, professional chemical supplier
Nanjing Chemical Material Corp. (NCMC), honored as the president unit of Nanjing Chemical Industry
Association, is reformed from original state-owned company which was found in 1955. NCMC has been
developing and focusing on chemicals for 70 years, and now is one of the largest professional
chemical suppliers in Jiangsu Province, with the privilege authorized by China government for
operation of hazardous chemicals, highly toxic chemicals, precursor and explosive chemicals. Taking
application development as the core mission, NCMC provides customers professional chemical services
with an integrated portfolio including manufacturing, R&D, trading, storage and logistics. The
products range includes basic chemicals, inorganic chemicals, intermediates, functional chemicals,
specialty and custom-made chemicals, covering total 14 application industries.

    Plater Group's Glossop site has had a long and varied history.

    provide power for the new Glossop Tramways. The first tram ran in August 1903 and the last on
    24th December 1927.
    
    The plot has been developed over the last 90 years, however some of the original rails can be
    seen around the site. The engine sheds pictured are still standing and now form part of Plater
    Production' spray drying manufacturing facility.

    communities and charitable organisations, in Glossop and Staffordshire.

    support to people living in neighbouring communities. The Plater Group team have taken part in
    several challenges raising funds for worthwhile charities.

    Our Team possess the values and skills that are essential to the service we provide to our
    customers.
    
    Our people are the backbone of our business and offer a wealth of knowledge, advice and support
    to deliver what we promise when we promise.
  * [Brand Values][89]
    As an established independent family owned company, we understand the industrial chemicals we
    supply and manufacture are an essential part of your businesses processes.
    
    Our acclaimed industry reputation is built on our core brand values which sets us apart from the
    competition.
    
    We understand industries and use our technical capability, advanced technology and established
    supply chain infrastructure to provide R&D and manufacturing solutions.
  * [History][90]
    Plater Group's Glossop site has had a long and varied history.
    The buildings were originally constructed in 1902, by the Urban Electricity Supply Company, to
    provide power for the new Glossop Tramways. The first tram ran in August 1903 and the last on
    24th December 1927.
    
    The plot has been developed over the last 90 years, however some of the original rails can be
    seen around the site. The engine sheds pictured are still standing and now form part of Plater
    Production' spray drying manufacturing facility.
  * [Community][91]
    Over the years, Plater Group has promoted and sponsored many initiatives in support of local
    communities and charitable organisations, in Glossop and Staffordshire.
    
    Local sporting clubs’ benefit from annual financial support, together with charities providing
    support to people living in neighbouring communities. The Plater Group team have taken part in
    several challenges raising funds for worthwhile charities.
  * [Compliance][92]
    Responding to our customers’ needs and providing peace of mind.
    
    Implementation of the required control systems enable us to meet all regulatory compliance and
    legislation, ensuring the chemicals and services we provide to you achieve consistent standards
    and exceed your expectations.

# For a world full of positive chemistry for all

The world is changing, and we are in the midst of it. As an internationally leading manufacturer for
phenolic, specialty urea, and melamine resins as well as high-quality derivatives of
methanol-(C1)-chemistry we are setting the future standards for excellent and sustainable quality.
We believe: Innovative chemistry may not only benefit our clients, but also the whole world and
future generations. That is why we supply our international customers quickly and reliably via short
distances from our 14 production sites around the world. We execute research projects on CO2-neutral
products using bio-based raw materials with a minimal carbon footprint. Why? Because we want to
support our clients to become fit for the future.

## Proven quality. Available also with green chemistry.

Are you interested in sustainable products that efficiently improve your carbon footprint? They are
already part of our portfolio today. If you cannot find your desired product, we are happy to
develop it together with you. More information about our sustainability concept “Mission Zero 2050”
is available here.

[Start your journey to sustainability with us][81]
Once you start including carbon footprint into your purchase decisions, many things appear in a very
different light.
Elmar Boeke, CEO Prefere Resins

## News

**Prefere Resins Group Announcement**
15 June 2026

Changes in Management

Christian Remus to lead the Group from October 1st, 2026, succeeding Elmar Boeke, who joins the
Advisory Board as Chairman · Emily Nuber appointed EVP Procurement & Supply Chain

[Read more][82]

Prefere Resins publishes first Group Sustainability Report
February 2025

We are pleased to announce the publication of our first Sustainability Report, emphasizing our
progress and achievements from 2023 to 2024 and our commitment to a more sustainable future.

[Read more][83]

## Prefere Phenolics

Get tailor-made phenolic and amino resins for your manifold uses in the construction industry, the
insulation industry and various special industrial applications – wherever you need us

# For a world full of positive chemistry for all

The world is changing, and we are in the midst of it. As an internationally leading manufacturer for
phenolic, specialty urea, and melamine resins as well as high-quality derivatives of
methanol-(C1)-chemistry we are setting the future standards for excellent and sustainable quality.
We believe: Innovative chemistry may not only benefit our clients, but also the whole world and
future generations. That is why we supply our international customers quickly and reliably via short
distances from our 14 production sites around the world. We execute research projects on CO2-neutral
products using bio-based raw materials with a minimal carbon footprint. Why? Because we want to
support our clients to become fit for the future.

## Proven quality. Available also with green chemistry.

Are you interested in sustainable products that efficiently improve your carbon footprint? They are
already part of our portfolio today. If you cannot find your desired product, we are happy to
develop it together with you. More information about our sustainability concept “Mission Zero 2050”
is available here.

[Start your journey to sustainability with us][81]
Once you start including carbon footprint into your purchase decisions, many things appear in a very
different light.
Elmar Boeke, CEO Prefere Resins

Hutubi Ruiyuantong Chemicals Co., Ltd. is a professional chemical company established in November
2013. It's a subsidiary of Zhenliang Chemical Group Co.,Ltd.

Factory area covering a land of 310 acres. With the total investment of 730 million yuan.

follows a business philosophy of full participation, risk control, continuous improvement, safety
first, prevention first, comprehensive management, and a business policy of quality first,
reputation first. The company's production line is divided into three phases. The first phase,
completed in 2014, established two production lines with an annual output of 100,000 tons of

## Latest News

[ [Cost Surges for Global Buyers.png] ][139]
July 24, 2026
[Cost Surges for Global Buyers: Impacts of Abolished Export Rebates on Phosphorus Flame Retardants &
DBNPA][140]

The abolition of China’s 13% export VAT rebate for phosphorus flame retardants and DBNPA pushes up
procurement costs for global buyers. Combined with volatile upstream phosphorus raw material prices,
suppliers keep adjusting quotations. Widely adopted in plastics, new energy, water treatment and
coatings, these chemicals squeeze overseas end-users’ profits. While large manufacturers ease
pressure through internal optimization, traders transfer cost increases downstream. Experts suggest
long-term contracts to hedge spot price volatility.

[Read More][141]
[ [Export VAT Rebates Canceled.png] ][142]
July 17, 2026
[China Cancels Export VAT Rebates for Phosphorus Flame Retardants and DBNPA Starting April 1,
2026][143]

Issued via China’s Announcement No.2 of 2026, a new policy cancels the original 13% export VAT
rebate for phosphorus flame retardants and industrial biocide DBNPA starting April 1, 2026, judged
by customs declaration date. Covering TCPP, ammonium polyphosphate and other mainstream chemicals,
the policy aims to upgrade resource-intensive chemical industries. It brings immediate cost hikes
for global importers, triggering frequent quotation adjustments and expected long-term price
fluctuations across the phosphorus chemical supply chain.

[Read More][144]
[ [DMDS (Dimethyl Disulfide)....png] ][145]
July 10, 2026
[DMDS (Dimethyl Disulfide): Advanced Presulfiding Agent for Petrochemical Catalyst Activation][146]

DMDS (CAS 624-92-0) with 99.5% high purity is a top-tier presulfiding agent for petrochemical
hydrogenation catalysts. It owns high sulfur content of over 68.1%, decomposes stably at moderate
temperatures to activate catalysts and avoid coking, outperforming DMS in efficiency and cost
control. Widely applied in refineries, ethylene plants and fine chemical synthesis. As a large
Chinese manufacturer with 20,000-ton annual capacity, we supply certified products, customized
technical schemes and stable global logistics for worldwide industrial clients.

## Latest News

[ [Cost Surges for Global Buyers.png] ][139]
July 24, 2026
[Cost Surges for Global Buyers: Impacts of Abolished Export Rebates on Phosphorus Flame Retardants &
DBNPA][140]

The abolition of China’s 13% export VAT rebate for phosphorus flame retardants and DBNPA pushes up
procurement costs for global buyers. Combined with volatile upstream phosphorus raw material prices,
suppliers keep adjusting quotations. Widely adopted in plastics, new energy, water treatment and
coatings, these chemicals squeeze overseas end-users’ profits. While large manufacturers ease
pressure through internal optimization, traders transfer cost increases downstream. Experts suggest
long-term contracts to hedge spot price volatility.

[Read More][141]
[ [Export VAT Rebates Canceled.png] ][142]
July 17, 2026
[China Cancels Export VAT Rebates for Phosphorus Flame Retardants and DBNPA Starting April 1,
2026][143]

Issued via China’s Announcement No.2 of 2026, a new policy cancels the original 13% export VAT
rebate for phosphorus flame retardants and industrial biocide DBNPA starting April 1, 2026, judged
by customs declaration date. Covering TCPP, ammonium polyphosphate and other mainstream chemicals,
the policy aims to upgrade resource-intensive chemical industries. It brings immediate cost hikes
for global importers, triggering frequent quotation adjustments and expected long-term price
fluctuations across the phosphorus chemical supply chain.

temperatures to activate catalysts and avoid coking, outperforming DMS in efficiency and cost
control. Widely applied in refineries, ethylene plants and fine chemical synthesis. As a large
Chinese manufacturer with 20,000-ton annual capacity, we supply certified products, customized
technical schemes and stable global logistics for worldwide industrial clients.

#### Analytics and Modelling

#### Insight Development

#### Actionable Deliverables

#### Follow Through and Measurement

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

### Informed Strategic Planning

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

## Strategic Revenue Advisory

where to focus, how to grow, and which capabilities matter most. We integrate market insight,

## Deliverables That Drive Revenue Decisions

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

### From Insight to Implementation

#### Data Collection

Structured gathering of market, customer, financial and competitive data from primary and secondary
sources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

Use of quantitative models and AI supported analysis to reveal patterns, stress points and leading
indicators.

#### Insight Development

Senior analysts translate findings into clear storylines and strategic implications.

#### Actionable Deliverables

Concrete recommendations, prioritised actions and quantified impact ranges.

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

### Informed Strategic Planning

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

### Faster, More Confident Execution

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

Our consultants are ready to support your next strategy cycle, investment decision or market entry
initiative with clear, evidence based insight.

## Who We Are

#### Our Mission

At 2B Chemical, our mission is to be the premier provider of chemical solutions, driving innovation
and progress across diverse industries. We are committed to delivering high-quality chemicals to the
pharmaceutical, painting, cosmetics, detergents, and beyond. Our focus is on fostering partnerships,
ensuring reliability, and exceeding customer expectations. Through strategic distribution and
unwavering dedication to quality, safety, and sustainability, we aim to empower our clients to
thrive and make a positive impact on the world. At 2B chemical, we don't just distribute chemicals;
we catalyze success for our partners in every formula.We believe that our success is dependent on
the success of our clients, and we work tirelessly to help them achieve their goals.

#### Our Expertise

At 2B Chemical, our unwavering commitment to excellence is underscored by our extensive expertise in
chemical distribution. As a leading force in the industry, we specialize in delivering top-tier
chemical solutions to a diverse array of sectors, including pharmaceuticals, paints, cosmetics,
detergents, and beyond. With a keen understanding of the unique requirements of each industry, our
team of seasoned professionals ensures that our clients receive unparalleled service and tailored
solutions. Whether it's sourcing high-quality raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations,
providing specialized pigments for vibrant paints, or delivering premium ingredients for cosmetics
and detergents, we take pride in being the trusted partner that propels your business forward.
Choose 2B Chemical for precision, reliability, and a steadfast commitment to meeting your chemical
needs across various industries.

#### Our Values

At 2B Chemical, integrity and innovation are the cornerstones of our values. We prioritize safety,
quality, and sustainability, ensuring the seamless supply of premium chemicals to pharmaceutical,
painting, cosmetics, detergents, and various industries. Committed to excellence, we foster
collaborative partnerships, driving progress and meeting diverse needs with reliability and
responsibility.

## Who We Are

#### Our Mission

At 2B Chemical, our mission is to be the premier provider of chemical solutions, driving innovation
and progress across diverse industries. We are committed to delivering high-quality chemicals to the
pharmaceutical, painting, cosmetics, detergents, and beyond. Our focus is on fostering partnerships,
ensuring reliability, and exceeding customer expectations. Through strategic distribution and
unwavering dedication to quality, safety, and sustainability, we aim to empower our clients to
thrive and make a positive impact on the world. At 2B chemical, we don't just distribute chemicals;
we catalyze success for our partners in every formula.We believe that our success is dependent on
the success of our clients, and we work tirelessly to help them achieve their goals.

#### Our Expertise

At 2B Chemical, our unwavering commitment to excellence is underscored by our extensive expertise in
chemical distribution. As a leading force in the industry, we specialize in delivering top-tier
chemical solutions to a diverse array of sectors, including pharmaceuticals, paints, cosmetics,
detergents, and beyond. With a keen understanding of the unique requirements of each industry, our
team of seasoned professionals ensures that our clients receive unparalleled service and tailored
solutions. Whether it's sourcing high-quality raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations,
providing specialized pigments for vibrant paints, or delivering premium ingredients for cosmetics
and detergents, we take pride in being the trusted partner that propels your business forward.
Choose 2B Chemical for precision, reliability, and a steadfast commitment to meeting your chemical
needs across various industries.

#### Our Values

At 2B Chemical, integrity and innovation are the cornerstones of our values. We prioritize safety,
quality, and sustainability, ensuring the seamless supply of premium chemicals to pharmaceutical,
painting, cosmetics, detergents, and various industries. Committed to excellence, we foster
collaborative partnerships, driving progress and meeting diverse needs with reliability and
responsibility.
